title: Why Freeman of the Land Fails | Magna Carta Myths, Common Law & Expatriation Explained
summary: Explainer on why freeman, common-law and Magna Carta defences fail in court, contrasted with lawful expatriation.

assertions.quote: The courts reject these arguments every single time.
Statute law always overrides common law if the two conflict.
Statute law applies to everyone and it overrides common law.
Out of the 63 clauses in 1215, only three still remain in UK law today.

verdicts.note: Three clauses (via the 1297 confirmation) remain on the statute book; the rest were repealed.

assertions.quote: so many people who have gone down this argument have been fined, lost their homes or even jailed
this pattern is across the UK, Australia, America, New Zealand, Canada
it's the only recognized way of saying, "I do not consent to this government's authority over me."

verdicts.note: Renunciation is lawful and ends citizenship, but not the authority of the country you live in, and tax obligations may remain.
